data.name: Bazigh
data.gender_notes: Bazigh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-z-gh', which means 'to be wise, learned, knowledgeable'. In Islamic tradition, Bazigh represents a wise and knowledgeable individual, revered for their wisdom and understanding. The name Bazigh carries the meaning “Wise, learned, knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bazigh usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, learned, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reflects the inner strength and wisdom of an individual, symbolizing their ability to lead and inspire others.
data.etymology: Bazigh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, learned, knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bazigh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Bazigh
in_english.meaning: One who is completely dependent on Allah, reliant on Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Bazigh refers to a person who is completely dependent on Allah and relies solely on Him for guidance, support, and salvation. This term signifies a deep sense of trust and reliance on Allah's will and mercy. It implies a state of being detached from worldly concerns and attachments, and instead being fully focused on pleasing Allah and following His commands.
